description: Every physical motion has a per se mover in its respect, from the five VIII.4 readings (all attributed, read literally, scoped to physical motion) and one added, unattributed premise (STMT-PER-ACCIDENS-MOVED-PASSIVE-MOTION-HAS-PER-SE-MOVER) that supplies what the literal disjunction lacks. Not a transcription: two-level case analysis, and premisesNeeded shows each of the six premises is needed (without the added premise, a light thing moved only by the remover of a hindrance has no per se mover). Its conclusion is restricted to physical motion; it reaches the prima via only through ARIST-PHYS-VIII-4-SCOPE-BRIDGE-TO-PRIMA-VIA.
